subject: Science
stem: An iron nail sinks in water, but a large wooden log floats, even though the log is much bigger. This is because iron has much greater mass packed into the same volume compared to wood — a property called:
explanation: Density (mass/volume) determines whether an object sinks or floats relative to a fluid — objects denser than water sink, while less dense objects (like wood, or a hollow ship's hull) float.
